description: OPTIONAL. Fetch a small version of the actual photo(s) of a menu item, room/facility type, event or venue so you can look at them and describe them to the guest. Meant for when the guest asks what something looks like. To just show a picture, the imageUrl / photos / coverImageUrl links in the other tools are enough. Returns up to 3 images (resized small) or a note that none exist. Use the id from list_menu_items, list_room_types, list_events or search_venues.
name: view_photos
title: View photos
